body.p: Tools that, once executed, cannot be undone or previewed by AI Positron are considered unsafe. These tools include all tools obtained through the Model Context Protocol integration and tools used to run command lines. By default, for such tools, the end user is explicitly asked in the chat box to allow the tool to run. When prompted, the end user can also choose to always allow a tool to run. In that case, the allowed tool is automatically added to the list of allowed tools on this preferences page.

The text area contains a line-separated list of tool name prefixes that are always allowed to run without asking the end user. The * character acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

For a tool that runs a command line, when the end user allows a certain command line, the prefix of that command line is also added to the tool name. Therefore, the user may always allow a command line such as git log to run, but they may want to be asked about any other command line.
For MCP tools, each tool call is initially approved individually. For example, when this single tool call is always allowed:
the preferences page is updated to contain this entry:
If you want to allow all tool calls to the MCP server, you can manually edit that entry to use the wildcard form brave-search_*.
The standalone wildcard * is not allowed as a single entry.
This preferences page can be saved at project level if you want to share a certain set of allowed tools with your team members.
